numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a bounded integer mass-accounting proxy for candidate fixtures without asserting measured earthworm mass.
numeric_parameters.risk: Proxy values could be mistaken for empirical body mass if the unit suffix and candidate boundary are removed.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Supports a dimensionless fixture density check and is not a physical volume estimate.
numeric_parameters.risk: No conversion to cubic meters or another real volume unit is authorized.

numeric_parameters.rationale: The fixed ratio makes the candidate mass-volume consistency oracle exact.
numeric_parameters.risk: This is an accounting identity and must not be described as biological density.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Bounds hypothetical soil displacement while preserving zero movement when location, energy, or habitat gates fail.
numeric_parameters.risk: No conversion to a real movement speed, burrowing rate, or soil effect is authorized.

conservation_contract.structural_mass: Every debit enters organism biomass, waste, dead biomass, retained detritus, or named pending owner custody.
conservation_contract.water: Every habitat-water debit enters body water, waste water, atmospheric proxy, dead biomass water, or named pending owner custody.
conservation_contract.energy_proxy: Every source debit enters organism stores, waste, dead biomass, dissipation, or named pending owner custody.
